model.label: Chat Model
model.description: Chat model in provider:name format dispatched via langchain.chat_models.init_chat_model (e.g. openai:gpt-4o, anthropic:claude-3-7-sonnet).

embed_model.label: Embedding Model
embed_model.description: Embedding model in provider:name format dispatched via langchain.embeddings.init_embeddings (e.g. openai:text-embedding-3-small, cohere:embed-english-v3.0).

embed_model.label: Embedding Model
embed_model.description: Default LlamaIndex embedding model name (e.g. text-embedding-3-small). The OpenAI default; for other vendors pass a pre-built BaseEmbedding instance to the operator.

llm_model.label: LLM Model
llm_model.description: Default LlamaIndex LLM model name (e.g. gpt-4o). The OpenAI default; for other vendors pass a pre-built LLM instance to the operator.

transport.label: Transport
transport.description: Transport type: http (default), sse, or stdio

command.label: Command
command.description: Command to run for stdio transport (e.g. uvx, python)

args.label: Arguments
args.description: JSON array of arguments for stdio command (e.g. ["mcp-run-python"])

model.label: Model
model.description: Model in provider:name format (e.g. anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-20250514, openai:gpt-5)

api_version.label: API Version
api_version.description: Azure OpenAI API version (e.g. 2024-07-01-preview). Falls back to OPENAI_API_VERSION.

region_name.label: AWS Region
region_name.description: AWS region (e.g. us-east-1). Falls back to AWS_DEFAULT_REGION env var.

aws_access_key_id.label: AWS Access Key ID
aws_access_key_id.description: IAM access key. Leave empty to use instance role / environment credential chain.

api_key.label: Bearer Token
api_key.description: AWS bearer token (alt. to IAM key/secret). Falls back to AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK.

base_url.label: Custom Endpoint URL
base_url.description: Override the Bedrock runtime endpoint URL (optional).

aws_read_timeout.label: Read Timeout (s)
aws_read_timeout.description: boto3 read timeout in seconds (float, optional).

aws_connect_timeout.label: Connect Timeout (s)
aws_connect_timeout.description: boto3 connect timeout in seconds (float, optional).

project.label: GCP Project
project.description: Google Cloud project ID. Falls back to GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT env var.

location.label: Location / Region
location.description: Vertex AI region (e.g. us-central1). Falls back to GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION env var.

vertexai.label: Force Vertex AI Mode
vertexai.description: Force Vertex AI mode. Auto-detected when project/location/credentials are set.

api_key.label: API Key
api_key.description: Google API key for Gen Language API or Vertex AI. Falls back to GOOGLE_API_KEY.

service_account_info.label: Service Account Info
service_account_info.description: Service account key as inline dict (JSON with type, project_id, private_key, etc.).

base_url.label: Custom Endpoint URL
base_url.description: Override the Google API base URL (optional).
